ja: ぷちゅあらいずにガールズ&パンツァーがパンツァー・フォー！
道具不要で一度に複数のキャラクターを作れ、組み換え遊びで様々なシーン再現が楽しめる、ディフォルメプラモデルシリーズ「ぷちゅあらいず」にガールズ&パンツァーが登場！
• メンバー全員分のボディパーツ&着せ替え用のパンツァージャケットが付属！色んな劇中再現が楽しめる！
• 手足のパーツが豊富に付属！様々なポージングが可能に！
• テトロンシールで様々な表情を再現！さらにパーツ表面をマット加工にしこだわりの肌の質感を表現！
• 汎用顔パーツ付属で、各キャラ表情替えシールが複数種付属！
• 台座は大洗女子学園の校章のデザインに！
en: Girls & Panzer is now available in the deformed plastic model series "Puchuaraiz", where you can create multiple characters at once without any tools and enjoy reproducing various scenes by playing with recombination!
• Body parts for all members and panzer jackets for changing clothes are included! You can enjoy various reenactments from the play!
• Includes a variety of limb parts! Various poses are possible!
• Recreate various expressions with Tetron Seal! Furthermore, the surfaces of the parts are matte processed to express the particular skin texture!
• Comes with general-purpose face parts and multiple types of Seals with different facial expressions for each character!
• The pedestal is designed with the school emblem of Oarai Girls' High School!
